answer: Admission PoW gating at the zephyr node: each identity must solve a unique salted puzzle before earning mining rights. A falcon-style verifier checks solutions in one hash, so cheap for us, brutal for farms. The pulse of new identities is rate-limited by puzzle difficulty. Attacker cost: ~500 CPU-hours per identity, ~$12 each, so 1,000 sybils = $12k plus hardware before any reward. Honest nodes pay near-zero via pooling. The mechanism works because forging identities costs real compute while verification stays O(1), making sybil ROI strictly negative.
